description: Caller reveals it's a wrong number — should be let go pleasantly, not pressed for details.

caller.persona: Someone who has misdialled. Apologetic, wants to hang up quickly. Has no plumbing problem at all.

facts.plumbing problem: none whatsoever — do not invent one

caller.goal: realise you have the wrong number and end the call politely. Never give any details, never describe a plumbing problem.
